title: Characterization of Ziziphus jujuba seeds and optimization of waffle formulations via D-optimal mixture design
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00822K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aman Jyoti, Mahendra Gunjal, Prasad Rasane, Supriya Singh Gaur, Sezai Ercisli, Jyoti Singh
The study enhanced the nutritional and bioactive profile of waffles by incorporating Ziziphus jujuba seed flour using a D-optimal design. Shelf-life and antioxidant stability were evaluated under different packaging and storage temperatures, with metallic polyester showing superior preservation.
